How we know what we say

Every key claim says what kind of claim it is.

Original texts and critical editions first, then named translations, then peer-reviewed scholarship, then lived tradition, always labelled as one community's view. We never cite blogs, forwards, quote sites or AI text.

Our editorial standards
Directly from a named text and edition
Belief or practice of a named tradition
Evidence-based historical scholarship
A live disagreement; both sides shown
